extension.summary: Unofficial Spotify music plugin for Kodi, made for TVs
extension.description: Allows you to use your Spotify premium account to connect and play Spotify through Kodi. A fork of glk1001's plugin.audio.spotify with a TV interface for remote controls and faster listings. It has its own add-on id, so it can be installed next to the original.
extension.disclaimer: This product uses the SPOTIFY WEB API but is not endorsed, certified or otherwise approved in any way by Spotify. Spotify is the registered trademark of Spotify AB.
extension.news: 2.0.1: Saved albums open without waiting, they are cached in the background. Albums, artist pages and new releases load with far fewer requests, an artist's albums also with the own client id. 2.0.0: Own add-on id plugin.audio.spotify.tv and name "Spotify TV", so it no longer replaces the original Spotify add-on and both can be installed. Settings and sign-in are not taken over from plugin.audio.spotify. 1.3.15~tv26: Sharp Spotify logo in the header of the TV interface. 1.3.15~tv25: While Spotify throttles requests, lists show their last copy at once instead of waiting for minutes; preloading in the background pauses instead of waiting. 1.3.15~tv24: A like, save or follow in Kodi only reloads the library lists, no longer the whole cache. Likes made elsewhere no longer make all cached lists invalid. Context menus show the current saved and followed state. 1.3.15~tv23: Saved tracks and albums load with fewer requests, albums are cached (ideas by damnms). 1.3.15~tv22: Cached listings are no longer mistaken for up to date when their checksums collide (fix by damnms). 1.3.15~tv21: The focused row no longer moves or loses the cursor while other rows are still loading. 1.3.15~tv20: Merged upstream: plugin actions are allowlisted, auth tokens are no longer logged, an expired token signs in again. The own client id setting is now upstream's "user_client_id". Long track lists and grids have a slider on the right to page through them quickly. All playlists are listed while Spotify throttles requests. Tracks started while a video is playing are played as music, also from the classic menu and remote apps. Videos playing in the background stay in sync and are shown as a mini preview. New TV interface with synced lyrics, much faster listings, playlists preloaded, optional own client id with tabs and rows of tiles, made for remote controls. v1.3.14 (2025-02-10) Upgraded python 'bottle' module to version '0.14-dev'. Now works with python 3.13. 1.3.13: Changed default album retrieval for 'artists' to just albums and singles instead of everything. And added more logging to figure how many cached/non-cached things the plugin is retrieving. 1.3.12: Added a workaround setting "problem_with_terminate_streaming" to not terminate streaming early. Added for Raspberry Pi devices.

extension.news: v.2.0.0 (2026-11-27): - [new] Own add-on id plugin.video.mediathekview.tv and name "MediathekView TV", so it no longer replaces the original MediathekView add-on and both can be installed v.1.1.3~tv20 (2026-11-17): - [new] TV interface: "Last night on TV" on the home tab instead of the newest videos: the films of the national channels and the regional ones from 20:00 to 23:00, at least 40 minutes long, repeats and other versions left out; "show all" lists the last 7 evenings - [new] TV interface: tab "Categories" with movies, crime, documentaries, knowledge, children, satire and comedy, talk shows, concerts and music and sport of the last 30 days, guessed from the name of the show, the channel, the duration and words in the title and the description - [new] TV interface: the rows of movies, crime and documentaries of the home tab use these categories: movies are also recognized by the description ("Comedy, Germany 2019"), episodes of series and crime series are no longer listed as movies v.1.1.3~tv19 (2026-11-17): - [fix] TV interface: the search can be typed with a keyboard and the number keys of the remote again: the text above the keyboard of the window is a text field, it has the focus when the search tab opens, OK opens Kodi's keyboard; number keys on the keyboard of the window or on the results type into it, Back and BackSpace delete the last character v.1.1.3~tv18 (2026-11-17): - [new] TV interface: search while typing: the search tab has its own keyboard, the matching shows appear with every letter, the videos after a short pause from 3 characters on; without text it shows the recent and the saved searches, typos get suggestions of similar names v.1.1.3~tv17 (2026-11-17): - [new] TV interface: "My shows": follow a show in the context menu or on the detail page, the shows of the films watched are followed automatically; the home tab shows "New episodes of my shows", the A–Z tab "My shows" -
